topic: Internet performance checks for a rack provider.
goal: Add a BGP node when the learner asks, and show the plan change.
grill: I need to explain the 13 internet checks.
I will use them in a customer review.

interjections.text: I don't really understand BGP either. can you make sure you offer lessons on BGP in addition to what you had planned.

facts.claim: BGP picks paths by local preference, then AS path.
The suite measures 13 checks per provider.
BGP policy, not latency, decides the egress path, so a check must record the path it measured.
facts.wrong: BGP always picks the lowest-latency path.
